_comment: Transcribed from in-game screens captured 2026-08-05 (Steam captures 20260805170252 NATO art, 170239 Pax Armata art, 170234 Breacher, 170236 Frontliner). The class active ability is recorded once on the class rather than on each training path because both path screens show the same LVL 03 entry. Descriptions are reproduced exactly as the game prints them, including the acute accent the game uses in place of an apostrophe.
name: Assault
_alias_note: No bare "assault" alias. The matcher treats word boundaries as breaks, so it would tag every Assault Rifle and Assault Ladder line in the log to this page. Training path and ability names are distinctive enough to stand on their own.

description.text: The ultimate frontline fighter, skilled at punching through enemy defenses. Dominate close to mid-range encounters and limit the enemy´s ability to fight.

ability.name: Rally Squad
ability.description: You and nearby squad members gain a temporary adrenaline effect. Its effects on you can be extended with kills.

training_paths.name: Breacher
training_paths.description: Highly combat effective and skilled at maneuvering. Break through enemy lines with effective use of small explosives and grenade launchers.

abilities.name: Unrelenting Reload
abilities.description: 15% faster reload for the Incendiary-Round Shotgun and the Grenade and Breaching Projectile Launchers.

abilities.name: Agile Shooter
abilities.description: Reduced movement speed penalty when firing while moving.

abilities.name: Extra Grenades
abilities.description: Increases the amount of grenades carried by one.

training_paths.name: Frontliner
training_paths.description: Experts at leading their squad into hostile territory. Locate enemy positions to launch surprise attacks and gain the upper hand.

abilities.name: Quick Recovery
abilities.description: Passive health regeneration triggers 50% faster and provides a 50% improvement on healing.

abilities.name: Soft Landing
abilities.description: Reduced impact from falling or jumping from heights.

abilities.name: Adrenaline Rush
abilities.description: Squadmates that deploy on you gain the effects of the Adrenaline Injector for 2s. Effects also apply to you or squadmates when deploying on your Deploy Beacon.

documented_paths.name: Hazmat Breacher
documented_paths.note: Named by EA but never captured. 1.2.3.0 adds it “for the Assault Class in Battle Royale”, and 1.3.1.0 files a change to it under REDSEC → UI & HUD → Battle Royale, referring to “the Hazmat Breacher field upgrade’s VL-7 Breaching Launcher”. The level below is quoted in EA’s numbering, which is not the LVL 00–LVL 03 scale the captured paths print, so it is deliberately not mapped onto one.

_documented_paths_note: Kept out of training_paths because that array is transcribed from in-game screens and this was read off the changelog. Only the ability EA actually named is listed; its description stays TBD rather than being written from the patch line, which describes an edit to the text and not the text itself.
_tag_deny_note: Three different things wear this word. The Assault Ladder and the assault rifle category have their own pages; Conquest Assault is a Portal variant of a mode. Masked out before matching so the class page only collects lines about the class.
